name: Asagami Towa
source:
A cheerful gyaru.

She has charisma that draws people in, and often does things that get those around her involved in fun activities.

She has a strong desire for approval, but at the same time, she is also very considerate of others.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.a-kaguya.com/products_cc/gyaru/index.html]official site[/url]]
